title: Noether R360 Paper 10 full-source-audit survival no-patch support
scope: Paper 10, Die Funktionalgleichungen der isomorphen Abbildung, printed pp. 536-545, on the R347 base.
summary: R360 applies no TeX patch and retains R347. It records that the current R347 Paper 10 span is normalized-identical to the earlier R333 Paper 10 span that was visually checked page by page against staged GDZ source witnesses. It preserves source-supported traps: the p543 four-line approximation system with dot-leader middle rows, the p544 rank-three sign pairing, and the p545 final real-x line plus theorem/date/footnote close.
evidence: R360 inherited R333 visual disposition ledgers
R333 and R347 Paper 10 span extracts
GDZ mixed400/600 full-page witnesses for printed pp. 536-545
targeted native400 readability crops for pp. 543-545
caveats: No TeX patch is made by R360.
This is current-base survival/anti-regression support against the earlier R333 page-by-page audit, not a fresh independent source audit from scratch.
The staged P10 witnesses are mixed 400/600ppi GDZ full-page JPGs and are below the preferred native650 threshold for most pages.
Included crops are native400 readability crops, not higher-resolution source upgrades.
This is not Paper 10 certification, not Noether closure, not multilingual synchronization, not strict native650/1000 source closure, and not critical-edition material.
